title: Spain’s Leader Is Seen as Soft on Migrants, but He Acted Fast on Ceuta
summary: After thousands poured into the Spanish territory in North Africa, the pro-immigration policies of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez were blamed. The reality is more complex.
